environment.timing: CUDA events around single CUDA Graph replays; compilation and capture excluded
environment.selector: torch key-min/max q-sign bound plus torch.topk(sorted=False); metadata construction excluded
limitations: No full LLM decode or task-quality measurement
Prediction construction cost excluded, previous-step IDs assumed available

Baseline is the same split-block prototype, not a vendor-optimized sparse-attention kernel

scope: Static CUDA Graph replay of complete selector + attention/repair, fixed Q/K/V and prediction IDs
